name: Tavrimo
features: REA timetable on the main screen

notes: The official REA portal supports group search and calendar export. Tavrimo uses a separate sync gateway to automate the official user flow; GitHub Pages alone cannot execute the required browser automation. Sync is best-effort: on launch/resume and every 15 minutes while the app is open and online.
